description: A man with a white lace collar and dark doublet hands a wax-sealed letter across a wooden table to a woman in a black headscarf and dark dress. A leather satchel of letters sits on the table, with a quill, inkwell and scattered coins, and a lit candle stands between them. A brass post horn hangs from a timber beam in a dim, low-ceilinged wooden room, with shadowy figures in hats in the background. No visible text, frame or border.
